x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.d: Inani labantu alisetyenziswa ngqo ekugqibeni ukhetho luka-Hana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.explain: Amagama kaHana asenokuthetha 'andikwazi ukuya ngenxa yovavanyo', okanye 'ndiza kuya ndifunde uvavanyo'. Ngoko kufuneka wazi ukuba iqela lelovavanyo olufanayo na, nokuba uHana ngumntu onjani xa efunda.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.0: Injongo yeqela lolona lwazi lubaluleke kakhulu kwisigwebo. Kungcono ngakumbi ukujonga nemikhwa yokufunda kaHana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.1: Imikhwa yokufunda ibalulekile, kodwa kufuneka ujonge nokuba iqela lelovavanyo olufanayo na.

x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga iindlela ezimbini uHana angazikhetha (eze afunde, afunde ekhaya).
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zama isakhelo 'Do you want to ...?' okanye 'If you ..., we could ...'.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba umyalezo unika uHana indawo yokukhetha ngaphandle kokumcinezela?

x-e-h1-07.title: Ingaba indlela entsha yebhayisikile yehlise iingozi ngenene?
x-e-h1-07.goal: Njengoko ubungqina bongezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha, phinda uvavanye ukuba ibango liyaholela kangakanani, uze ucacise ngezizathu ukuba lelinani elisombulula ingxaki.
x-e-h1-07.material: Libango elisuka kwinqaku lesixeko. "The new bike lane made our street safer." Funda amacebiso ngokulandelelana.
x-e-h1-07.prereq.0: Ukufunda inqaku elifutshane lesiNgesi kwinqanaba lonyaka wokuqala wesikolo samabanga aphezulu
x-e-h1-07.prereq.1: Ukuqonda kwemihla ngemihla okwanele ukwahlula 'umlinganiselo' kwi-'nani'
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Rhoqo xa ufunda icebiso, gweba ukuba ibango lixhaswa kangakanani.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuba icebiso elitsha linika esinye isizathu esinokucacisa inani langaphambili na.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlula ukuba inani ngu-'iimeko ezingaphi' okanye 'iimeko ezingaphi ngabantu abangaphi'.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ukusuka kweli cebiso kuphela, ibango lixhaswa kangakanani?
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngaphantsi kunenyanga efanayo kunyaka odlulileyo ikhomisa kwicala elifanayo nebango, kodwa yinyanga enye kuphela.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Zimbalwa kakhulu iingcebiso zokugqiba ngenani lenyanga enye.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Lixhaswa kwinqanaba elithile, kodwa yinyanga enye kuphela, ngoko kufuneka sijonge ngakumbi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Jonga eli cebiso litsha uze utshintshe isigwebo sakho ngebango.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Awunakuxela ukuba iingozi zehle ngenxa yendlela okanye kuba abambalwa abakhwele xa imvula inetha.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ibango lithe buthathaka. Iingozi zisenokuba zehle kuba abambalwa abakhwele iibhayisikile.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuba bambalwa abakhwelayo, iingozi nazo zinokwehla.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lithe buthathaka kuphela; asilubungqina bokuba ngamanga.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Funda ukuya kwicebiso lokugqibela uze ushwankathele isigwebo sakho.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Ixesha laba lide, kwaye nangona inani labakhweli landa, umlinganiselo weengozi wehla, ngoko ubuthathaka bokuqala bamiliselwa. Noko ke, awukwazi ukuthi akukho esinye isizathu nakancinci.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kongezwe uthelekiso olujonga ixesha lonyaka omnye nenani labakhweli.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kungqinisisiwe ukuba indlela sesona sizathu sodwa.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Le datha ayinakukuxelela ukuba isizathu 'sesinye kuphela'.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Kwicebiso elingaphi ukholo lwakho lutshintshe kakhulu? Thetha isizathu kwisivakalisi esinye.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Kutheni 'iingozi ngabakhweli abangama-1,000' kwinyathelo 3 kungcono ekusombululeni ingxaki yenyathelo 2?
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khumbula ukuba yintoni ngenani leengozi eyayiyingxaki kwinyathelo 2.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.a: Kuba yenza inani leengozi libonakale likhulu ngakumbi, ngoko liyavela
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.a: Inani elibonakala likhulu nothelekiso olufanelekileyo zizinto ezahlukeneyo.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.b: Ngumgangatho wokubala otshintshileyo; asiyiyo ukuba kubalwa iingozi ezingakumbi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.c: Kuba unokuthelekisa ngokufanelekileyo nokuba inani labakhweli liyatshintsha
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.explain: Ukuba uthelekisa amanani kuphela, awukwazi ukuxela ukuba iingozi zehle ngenxa yendlela xa bambalwa abakhwelayo. Ukuba utshintsha kwiingozi ngabantu abangama-1,000, unokunciphisa impembelelo yenani labantu uze uthelekise.

x-e-h1-08.title: Ingaba imithombo emibini ayivumelani ngenene?
x-e-h1-08.goal: Fumana umgca ongalunganga kushwankathelo lwemithombo emibini uze uwulungise, uze ukhethe isenzo esilandelayo sokusombulula ukuphikisana.
x-e-h1-08.material:
Le yimithombo emibini noshwankathelo lomfundi (amanani emigca yeshwankathelo aqala ku-1).

Source A (city news, March 3): "The Hanbit Library reopened on March 1 after repairs. It now opens seven days a week, and about 300 people visited on the first day."
Source B (library blog, March 5): "We reopened on March 2. We are open six days a week, closed on Mondays. More than 300 visitors came on our first day!"

x-e-h1-08.prereq.1: Ingqiqo yemihla ngemihla yenani eyanelisayo ukugweba ukuba 'malunga ne-300' kunye ne-'ngaphezulu kwe-300' ziyahambelana
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye ongalunganga kushwankathelo lomfundi. (Nokuba imigca emibini okanye ngaphezulu ayilunganga, kufuneka ukhethe omnye kuphela.)

x-e-h1-08.s.s1.explain: Imigca 3 no-5 yingxaki. 'Malunga ne-300' kunye ne-'ngaphezulu kwe-300' zombini zinokuba yinyaniso, ngoko inani labandwendwe asikho ukuphikisana (umgca 3). Umgca 5 uthi omnye umthombo awulunganga, kodwa awukwazi ukuxela ngalo mbhalo kuphela ukuba yiwuphi ongalunganga. Ukuphikisana kwemigca 2 no-4 kwangempela.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.prompt: Cinga ukuba umgca kushwankathelo othelekisa amanani abandwendwe bemithombo emibini awulunganga, uze ulungise loo mgca, uwubhale kwizivakalisi ezi-1 okanye ezi-2 zesiNgesi. Quka ukuba amanani abandwendwe emithombo emibini anxulumene njani.

x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuba "about" kunye ne-"more than" nganye ichaza uluhlu lwamanani luni.

x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale amagama emithombo emibini (Source A/B) okanye iintetho zawo ngqo?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.modelNote.2: Yabonisa ngenani elikhonkrithi (310) ukuba ezi zimbini zinokuba yinyaniso zombini.

x-e-h1-10.title: Ukwenza incoko enqaba isimemo ngelixa kugcinwa ubudlelwane
x-e-h1-10.topic: Ukubhala impendulo okanye incoko ehlangabezana neemeko
x-e-h1-10.goal: Zibhalele ngokwakho incoko emfutshane yesiNgesi ehlangabezana nazo zonke iimeko (ukwala okucacileyo, isizathu, enye indlela, nokuqonda komnye umntu).
x-e-h1-10.material: Umhlobo A umemela u-B ukuba aye kwikhonsathi kunye ngo-7 p.m. ngoMgqibelo. U-B unemicimbi yosapho ngalo mbandela kwaye akakwazi ukuya.
x-e-h1-10.prereq.0: Ukufunda nokubhala incoko emfutshane yesiNgesi kwinqanaba lonyaka wokuqala wesikolo samabanga aphezulu
x-e-h1-10.prereq.1: Iindlela eziyisiseko ezisetyenziswayo xa ungakwazi ukwamkela isimemo
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi indlela efanelekileyo ngakumbi yokuba u-B arhoxe?
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Jonga ukuba u-A, emva kokuva impendulo nganye, angaxela 'ukuba u-B unokuya okanye hayi'.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.a: Icacile, kodwa ithoni yehlisa isimemo somnye umntu.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.c: "I'll try" ayicaci ukuba kukwala okanye kukwamkela, ngoko kunzima ukuba omnye umntu enze izicwangciso.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.explain: Xa kukho ukwala okucacileyo (can't), isizathu, nenye indlela (olunye usuku) zikunye, omnye umntu akaqondi gwenxa kwaye akonzakali kangako. Impendulo engacacanga ilindisa omnye umntu, kwaye intetho eqatha kakhulu ibeka uxinzelelo ekunxibelelaneni.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.prompt:
Yenza incoko phakathi kuka-A no-B ngesiNgesi. Qalisa umgca ngamnye nge-A: okanye B:, ubhale imigca ebuncinane emi-4.
Umqathango 1) U-B uthi ngokucacileyo ukuba akanakuya (can't, njalo njalo).
Umqathango 2) U-B unika isizathu.
Umqathango 3) U-B ucebisa olunye usuku okanye enye indlela.
Umqathango 4) U-A ubonisa impendulo eqondayo.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Qala unqume isizathu (isiganeko sosapho, njalo njalo) nenye indlela (olunye usuku), uze ucwangcise ulandelelwano lwemigca.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ulandelelwano kwimpendulo yokuqala ka-B: faka 'enkosi', uze usebenzise can't.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ukwala kuka-B 'kucacile', okanye akucaci njenge-'try to come'?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba enye indlela ngumbono onokwenziwa ngokwenene (ingaba kukho umhla okanye indlela)?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Yahlangabezana nemiqathango efanayo nokuba imeko itshintshile.
